data.long_meaning: Elvika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Elvi' meaning Goddess and 'Ka' meaning Grace. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Elvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of grace and live with faith, good character and purpose.
